transforms.name: assistant-text
transforms.effect: An assistant message event carries text and a final flag.

transforms.name: reduce-message
transforms.effect: Nonblank text replaces the actor reply. final false also marks responding.

transforms.name: derive-reply
transforms.effect: Blank text is omitted. Otherwise text, optional at, and final are copied.
